admission.justification: The first-start refusal named an atomic series-contract edge and no remedy, and a terminal generation could otherwise be treated as a found enclosure; the obligation spans the refusal translator, the terminal check and the child transport, and the terminal and stale-recovery cases are guarded by focused tests.

applicability: Every refusal of the shared role-start preparation, on the launcher's answer and on role_start.
conditions: The refusal names what could not be prepared, the worktree start's own status and reason, and the next step a person or agent can take.
A terminal enclosure generation refuses before any root is used or any enclosure is created, names reopen-required and previews the exact contract's task_reopen.
A stale-source block keeps the native recovery fields and directs the owner to the explicit stale_base_choice rather than inventing a missing-contract inspection.
A refusal leaves nothing half-made; a cut-off preparation names what may remain and how it is repaired or abandoned.
exclusions: The worktree start's own checks and parameters stay as they are; the start only changes the hint it passes.
A refusal for an open execution, a start rule or the launch lock is the launcher's existing line.
